what: Four-arm external baseline on the version-of-record 218-query workload with identical deterministic scorers

cowrie.notes: vanilla Cowrie semantics: scripted command output, no LLM, no CTI

llm_unverified.notes: bare LLM honeypot (deepseek-v4-flash-free): persona prompt on the wire, no retrieval/graph/verifier/fallback

stateful_llm.notes: stateful LLM honeypot (deepseek-v4-flash-free, HoneyGPT/LLM-SSHH pattern): committed host-state register in prompt + transcript memory + LLM self-validation; no retrieval, no fiction graph, no deterministic verifier, no fail-closed fallback

rag_no_verifier.notes: grounded pipeline (Chrollo+Don+Hisoka+fiction graph+steering) with the serving-time verifier replaced by a pass-through

ragin_full_reference.notes: verified deception loop (version of record, run 1)

reading: Composite ladder: cowrie=0.0006 < llm_unverified=0.5018 < stateful_llm=0.0704 < rag_no_verifier=0.8163 < ragin_full_reference=0.8474. The stateful-LLM pattern (2026 practice: state register + transcript + LLM self-validation) collapses on the CTI workload; bare unverified generation partially compensates but with zero safety guarantees; grounding (rag_no_verifier) recovers technique/actor scores; the deterministic verifier (ragin_full_reference) holds quality at near-parity while closing the safety boundary.
